func TestGoAdopterSplit(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name, src, want string
	}{
		{"declarations",
			"package x

import "b"

// F doc.
func F() {}

func (t *T[K]) M() {}

type T struct{}
",
			"header
residual
unit addImport path=b
residual
unit setFunction F
residual
unit setMethod M recv=T
residual
unit setType T"},
		{"grouped import and block",
			"package x

import (
	"a"
	"b"
)

const (
	A = iota
	B
)
",
			"header
residual
unit setImports imports#1
residual
unit setConst A"},
		{"aliased import",
			"package x

import f "fmt"
",
			"header
residual
unit setImports imports#1"},
		{"repeated names",
			"package x

func init() {}

func init() {}

var _ = 1
var _ = 2
",
			"header
residual
unit setFunction init#1
residual
unit setFunction init#2
residual
unit setVar _
unit setVar _#2"},
		{"package doc is a residual before the header",
			"// Package x does things.
package x
",
			"residual
header"},
		{"floating comment",
			"package x

// floating

func F() {}
",
			"header
residual
unit setFunction F"},
		{"cgo import",
			"package x

// #include <stdio.h>
import "C"
",
			"header
residual
residual"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			spans, err := GoAdopter{}.Split("p/x.go", []byte(tc.src))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := Coverage([]byte(tc.src), spans); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got := goSummary(spans); got != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("spans:
%s
want:
%s", got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
